name: Ice Cream Shoppe
description: Step into a world of frozen delight where vibrant colors dance and tantalizing flavors sing. This charming ice cream shoppe is a sensory wonderland, inviting you to indulge in a symphony of taste and sight. Your eyes are drawn to the mesmerizing array of ice cream scoops, each one a masterpiece of color and texture. Visit the Shoppe on Spatial.io!
loopring_to_taiko_migration: If you are an Ice Cream holder on Loopring & wish to migrate your NFT to Taiko; you will need to contact me on Discord / X (Twitter) so I can facilitate the process with you. Please see my Linktree for social links.
